title: xfr-engine: deterministic financial engine for the shadow price of credit
description: Python implementation of the mathematical core of the manuscript 'The Shadow Price of Credit: An Explainable-AI Decision-Support System for Corporate Recapitalization under Credit-Line Withdrawal' (M. de Alencar Netto, 2026): cash and debt identities, minimum-equity linear program (HiGHS), credit-to-equity substitution index (CES/ISC), directional shadow price of credit capacity, infeasibility diagnosis, and 26 automated consistency tests covering Section 9, Appendix A and the directional form of the paper.

creators.name: de Alencar Netto, Mario
creators.affiliation: XMA Capital S.A., Palhoça, SC, Brazil
